exposure: Women who had expectant management defined as births 'at next week'
Women who had expectant management defined as all births at 'next week or beyond'
cohort: 447,066 singleton term and post-term hospital births in Austria between 2008 and 2016
finding: The definition of the expectant management group significantly impacts the analysis of IOL outcomes, and defining expectant management as births 'at the next week' may better inform clinical decision-making.
mod_finding: Non-medically indicated IOL was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery at 37 and 38 weeks, reduced odds at 40 and 41 weeks, and comparable odds at 39 weeks when expectant management was defined as all births at 'next week or beyond', but significantly lower odds when expectant management was defined as births 'at the next week'.
